display_name: Every munition's shape, motor, smoke and charge, and the guns' rounds
status: First pass, 31 October 2026 (docs/fx/README.md section 3.2): every weapon of data/air_war/weapons.json, our 9M33M2 and 9M33M3, the neighbours' SAMs and MANPADS, the ARMs, the cruise missiles and the guns' rounds. Presentation data: what a weapon looks like and how its motor, smoke and tracer show, never what it does (that is weapons.json's game values).
source: per munition (each entry's source); fin chords: estimate (only pvo_guns gave any, the V-600P's wing; trace photos by docs/MODELLING_FROM_PHOTOS.md to replace them)
notes: Loaded by simcore/scenery/munitions.hpp (MunitionLibrary; BuildMesh, BuildPart). Positions along the body (x, w, nose_l, tail_l) are fractions of the length from the nose; a fin set's x is its root's leading edge, its span twice a tip's distance from the axis, its roll the first fin's angle from right toward up. charge_kg is the warhead's TNT equivalent (a cluster's: one submunition's), on one basis for every bomb: the TNT equivalent where a source gives it (Bazalt's for the Soviet bombs, valka_weapons), else the explosive's mass times its filler's factor (tritonal 1.07; TNT 1; the FAB-500 M-62's TGAF 300 / 207 = 1.45, Bazalt's equivalent over yugoimport_bombs' fill); a fill whose explosive no source names takes its series' factor where a sibling's is known (the FAB-250 M-62 the FAB-500 M-62's), else is taken as TNT (the FAB-500ShN), an estimate that may fall short by up to that factor. smoke_s is how long the trail lingers (game value, 30-60 s for smoky motors). A round's rate_rpm is the whole mount's; barrels the separate streams (a rotary gun fires one). The maps: weapons (weapons.json id), systems (air defence system id, simcore/air_war/data.hpp), models (basic model id), aliases (the EM library's ARMs, 9m33) to a munition. Colours: US bombs olive drab with a yellow band, US missiles white with a yellow band on the warhead and a brown one on the motor (mil_std_709c); Soviet and other colours are estimates.
